anchor.text: ad pulcritudinem tria requiruntur, integritas, consonantia, claritas
anchor.prefix: ying relations of the sensible must therefore correspond to the necessary phases of artistic apprehension. Find these and you find the qualities of universal beauty. Aquinas says:
anchor.suffix:
. I translate it so: Three things are needed for beauty, wholeness, harmony and radiance. Do these correspond to the phases of apprehension? Are you following?

 —Of course, I am,
